visualReview.notes: Inspected the finished four-sided turntable and detailed views. The model shows the pink north arcade with four openings, the three west entrances, the large rose and the octagonal bell stage and tall ribbed spire. Roof planes and skylights stay visible in the rear view.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected nine shared-surface captures and confirmed unload. Salmon plaster, pale mouldings, dark recessed doors and glazed tracery remain separate. The steeple’s ribbing, cross and crockets read separately against the sky.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected 25 contextual frames. All four detail levels retain the narrow steeple, north arcade and three-part broad façade. District clarifies the rose and pinnacles, while street and closeup resolve the curved trim, fretwork, small crockets and cresting.

geographicReview.notes: The exact named OpenStreetMap perimeter aligns the façade to Avenida Norte 2 opposite Plaza Andrés Eloy Blanco and puts the long side on Avenida Urdaneta. Inspected the original 256 m field and the terrain-mounted preview. The steep coarse elevation changes along Urdaneta leave near-door foundation and exact threshold heights approximate.

fidelityReview.scope: Standing neo-Gothic exterior of the Santa Capilla basilica in central Caracas, including the three-bay west façade, central spire, northern street elevation and principal nave roofs.
fidelityReview.notes: Two exact CC0 photographs show the surviving pink finish, north arcade, circular tracery, octagonal bell stage and ribbed spire. The published conservation account establishes the rebuilt Gothic portal and concrete roof arrangements. Spire height, west tracery and fine sculpture and the less visible service elevation are estimates.

imageryReview.notes: Reviewed 15 Qualla families first. The sole public-domain original was an interior painting. Used two exact Wilfredor originals with native CC0 releases, covering the full north arcade and the main steeple in detail. The earlier stereograph and other catalogue images are absent from authored controls.

validation.sharedCaptureScope: Standing Santa Capilla basilica exterior in Caracas, including the north street wall, west portal, bell stage, spire and nave roofs.

limitations: The footprint is the named mapped 27.8 m entrance front and approximately 34 m principal basilica depth. Surrounding buildings and street objects are outside the model.

Two exact 2014 exterior originals control the salmon, pale mouldings, prominent Urdaneta side arches and octagonal steeple. The west portal follows the restoration architect’s description. Its opening sizes, the rose and fine sculpture use approximate profiles.

The 30.05 m cross finial height, lancet positions, unpictured roof equipment and the less visible rear elevation are working estimates. The principal roofs follow documented concrete covers and the central skylight arrangement.
The original terrain is unchanged. Local street grade, threshold levels and height against the mapped terrain remain approximate.
